note: 被哥布林女王抛弃的哥布林王,用 Goblin Egg 换取「王之气味」效果,好让玩家混进女王巢穴拿 Amber 水晶。

messages.raw: §fDid ya hear that, %s? That's the sound of an empty stomach.
messages.text: Did ya hear that, %s? That's the sound of an empty stomach.
messages.zh: 听见了吗,%s?那是空肚子叫的声音。

messages.raw: §fI've been so hungry since the Goblin Queen tossed me aside
messages.text: I've been so hungry since the Goblin Queen tossed me aside
messages.zh: 自从被哥布林女王一脚踢开,我就一直饿着

messages.raw: §fBring me back a Goblin Egg of any type and we can teach her a lesson!
messages.text: Bring me back a Goblin Egg of any type and we can teach her a lesson!
messages.zh: 随便给我带一颗哥布林蛋回来,咱们就能好好教训她一顿!

messages.raw: §fBring me any type of Goblin Egg and we can show the Goblin Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!
messages.text: Bring me any type of Goblin Egg and we can show the Goblin Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!
messages.zh: 随便给我带一颗哥布林蛋,咱们就让哥布林女王也尝尝失去心爱之物的滋味?!

messages.raw: §fThat is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a §9Goblin Egg§f and you will satiate my hunger.
messages.text: That is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a Goblin Egg and you will satiate my hunger.

segments.text: That is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a
segments.zh: 这绝对不是我要的那顿饭! 给我带一颗

segments.text: and you will satiate my hunger.
segments.zh: 回来,才能填饱我的肚子。

messages.raw: §fWhere is that §9Goblin Egg§f? My Chef is waiting!
messages.text: Where is that Goblin Egg? My Chef is waiting!

messages.raw: §fThese eggs will help me stomach my pain.
messages.text: These eggs will help me stomach my pain.
messages.zh: 有了这些蛋,我这份痛苦总算能咽下去了。

messages.raw: §fNow let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her §6Amber Crystal§f!
messages.text: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her Amber Crystal!

segments.text: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her
segments.zh: 现在就往女王的痛处上戳——把她的

messages.raw: §fI'm covering you in my §afoul stench §ras we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!
messages.text: I'm covering you in my foul stench as we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!

segments.zh: 我这就往你身上抹我的

segments.text: as we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!

messages.raw: §fGet to the Queen before my stench goes away and you'll be able to sneak past her imbecile Guards!
messages.text: Get to the Queen before my stench goes away and you'll be able to sneak past her imbecile Guards!
messages.zh: 趁我的臭味还没散,赶到女王那儿去,你就能从她那帮蠢卫兵眼皮底下溜过去!

messages.raw: §fYou must hurry! Get to the Goblin Queen before my stench escapes you!
messages.text: You must hurry! Get to the Goblin Queen before my stench escapes you!
messages.zh: 你得快点! 赶在我的臭味散掉之前找到哥布林女王!

messages.raw: §fYou need my §afoul stench §fagain? Bring me a §9Goblin Egg §fof any type!
messages.text: You need my foul stench again? Bring me a Goblin Egg of any type!
